import Mathlib

theorem p03 (n : ℕ) : 6 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
  have h2mod : n % 2 = 0 ∨ (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := by
    omega
  have h3mod : n % 3 = 0 ∨ (n + 1) % 3 = 0 ∨ (n + 2) % 3 = 0 := by
    omega
  have h2 : 2 ∣ n ∨ 2 ∣ n + 1 := by
    rcases h2mod with h | h
    · left
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h
    · right
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h
  have h3 : 3 ∣ n ∨ 3 ∣ n + 1 ∨ 3 ∣ n + 2 := by
    rcases h3mod with h | h | h
    · left
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h
    · right
      left
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h
    · right
      right
      exact Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h
  have h2prod : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
    rcases h2 with h | h
    · simpa [mul_assoc] using dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h ((n + 1) * (n + 2))
    · exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h n) (n + 2)
  have h3prod : 3 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
    rcases h3 with h | h | h
    · simpa [mul_assoc] using dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h ((n + 1) * (n + 2))
    · exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h n) (n + 2)
    · exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h (n * (n + 1))
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime 2 3 := by
    norm_num
  simpa using hcop.mul_dvd h2prod h3prod
